# Functions

To reduce code, we will generate some functions here. 

```{r definition, echo=F}
# function to generate a vulcano plot for differentially expressed genes
GenerateVolcanoPlot <- function(fit, variable, file) {
  # get all hits
  hits <- topTable(fit, coef = variable, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  total <- nrow(hits)
  # get first hit after FDR 10% for drawing a p-value threshold line
  index <- if(length(which(hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1)) == 0) 0 else which(hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1)
  threshold <- hits[index[length(index)] + 1, "P.Value"]
  ### volcano plot ###
  # label only significant hits (if more than 10)
  g <- ggplot(hits, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) + 
    theme_bw(base_size = 22) + 
    geom_point() + 
    xlim(-2, 2) + 
    ylim(0, 6) +
    xlab(bquote(~Log[2]~ "fold change")) +
    ylab(bquote(~-Log[10]~ italic(P))) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank()) +
    labs(caption = paste0("Total variables: ", total)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(threshold), linetype = "dashed")
 if(length(index) >= 10){
    g + geom_point(data = hits[index, ], aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)), colour = "red2", size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[index[1:10], ], aes(label = gene_name), colour = "red2")
  # else: label hit genes (if some are found) purple and following genes green until a maximum of 10 genes is labeled
  } else if(length(index) == 0) {
    g + geom_text_repel(data = hits[1:10, ], aes(label = gene_name))
  } else {
    g + geom_point(data = hits[index, ], aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)), colour = "red2", size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[index, ], aes(label = gene_name), colour = "red2") +
    geom_point(data = hits[(length(index) + 1):10, ], aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value)), size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = hits[(length(index) + 1):10, ], aes(label = gene_name))
  }
  g
  ggsave(paste0(outpath, "/", file), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
}

# function to plot all differentially expressed hits for the different covariates corrected for all other covariates as a vertical barplot
GenerateVerticalBarplotOfDiffExprHits <- function(design, fit, from, to, plot_name){
  # Get padj values for all different covariates
  nc <- ncol(design) - 1
  limma_res_fc <- topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf)
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_fc[, from:(to + nc)]
  for (i in 1:nc){
    limma_res_padj[, i] = topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, "adj.P.Val"]
    if(i == nc){
      limma_res_padj$`Ensembl Gene ID` = topTable(fit, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, "gene_id"]
    }
  }
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_padj[, -c(length(limma_res_padj) - 1)] # remove SV1
  colnames(limma_res_padj) <- c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death1", "Type_of_Death2", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "Ensembl Gene ID") # "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID")
  limma_res_padj$Type_of_Death <- (limma_res_padj$Type_of_Death1 + limma_res_padj$Type_of_Death2) / 2
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_padj[, c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "Ensembl Gene ID")]# "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID")]
  # unmerge Gene Ensembl IDs at their vertical dash "|"
  limma_res_padj <- unique(separate_rows(limma_res_padj, `Ensembl Gene ID`, sep = "\\|")) 
  # change data.frame into data.table to get the minimal adjusted p-value for each unique Ensembl Gene IDs (some can be found multipe times!!)
  limma_res_padj <- as.data.table(limma_res_padj)
  limma_res_padj <- limma_res_padj[, lapply(.SD, min), by = 'Ensembl Gene ID']
  # check, how many padj values are < 0.10
  limma_res_padj_0.1 <- apply(limma_res_padj[, -1], 2, function(x) sum(x < 0.1))
  limma_res_plot <- data.frame(sort(limma_res_padj_0.1, decreasing = T))
  # vertical barplot with ggplot2
  ggplot(limma_res_plot, aes(y = limma_res_plot$sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T., x = reorder(row.names(limma_res_plot), sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T.))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 22)) +
    ylab("# significant hits") +
    xlab("") +
    geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = limma_res_plot$sort.limma_res_padj_0.1..decreasing...T.), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
  ggsave(paste0(outpath, "/", plot_name))
  return(limma_res_plot)
}

# function, which first generates the contingency table for two datasets and then calculates the p-value using fisher exact test
# return: the p-value calculated using fisher exact test
FishersExactTest <- function(data1, data2, background){
  data1  <- unique(sort(unlist(data1)))
  data2 <- intersect(data2, background)  # take only the genes, which are also in the background data
  a <- length(intersect(data1, data2))  # all genes in data1 and data2
  b <- length(data1) - a  # all genes in data1, but NOT in data2
  x <- length(setdiff(data2, data1))  # all genes in data2, but NOT data1
  y <- length(background) - length(data1) - x  # all genes NOT in data1 or data2
  contingency_matrix <- matrix(c(a, x, b, y), 2, 2)
  #print(contingency_matrix)
  result <- fisher.test(contingency_matrix, alternative = "greater")
  return(result$p.value)
}
```

## Diagnosis with sex and diagnosis interaction model

### Load Data

```{r}

```

### Volcano Plot

```{r}
# volcano plot
```

### Boxplot

For the TRIM10 hit, we will plot the residuals of sex vs. diagnosis as this gene infers a difference between these two covariates:
```{r, echo = F}
# load data
load(paste0(inpath, "/1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis.RData"))
# generate boxplot with case vs control for male and female samples of the hit gene (TRIM10)
trim10 <- res[rownames(res) == "ENSG00000204613.6", ]
trim10 <- t(t(as.data.frame(trim10)))
trim10 <- merge(trim10, pData[, c("ShortName", "Dx", "Sex")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName", all.x = T)
trim10$DxSex <- paste0(trim10$Dx, trim10$Sex)
pdf(paste0(outpath, "/1.2_boxplot_TRIM10_diff_expr_genes_for_diagnosis_with_sex_dx_interaction.pdf"), width = 7, height = 6)
ggplot(trim10, aes(Sex, trim10, fill = Dx)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Female", "Male")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(3), labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) + 
  ggtitle("TRIM10") +
  ylab("Gene expression") + 
  xlab("Sex") + 
  labs(fill = "Diagnosis")
dev.off()
# p-value females
females <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "F",]
case <- females[females$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- females[females$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.01022
# p-value males
males <- trim10[trim10$Sex == "M",]
case <- males[males$Dx == "CASE",]
control <- males[males$Dx == "CTL",]
t.test(case$trim10, control$trim10) # p-value = 0.05302
# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit, res, trim10, females, males, case, control)
```

## Figures for the tDEGenes

Now, we generate some plots for the six found tDEGenes for diagnosis. First, we will plot a heatmap of the six tDEGenes.
```{r, echo = F}
# load RData file
load(paste0(inpath, "/2.4_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
# get only top hits (6 tDEGenes)
top_hits <- top_hits[top_hits$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
# ǵenerate heatmap of hits
anno <- pData(transcript_summaries)[, c("Age", "PMI", "RIN", "Sex", "Suicide", "Dx", "ShortName")]
rownames(anno) <- anno$ShortName
anno$ShortName <- NULL
pheatmap(exprs(transcript_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID`, ], scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, show_colnames = F)
pheatmap(exprs(transcript_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID`, ], scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, show_colnames = F, filename = paste0(outpath, "/2.4_heatmap_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"))
rm(anno)
```

Then, we plot the up and down regulated genes into one barplot with the two variables mirrored on the x-axis.
```{r, echo = F}
logfc <- as.data.frame(table(top_hits$logFC))
logfc$group <- "Upregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "group"] <- "Downregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "Freq"] <- -1
logfc$Var1 <- abs(round(as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)), 2))
logfc$logfc <- 2^logfc$Var1
logfc$linearFC <- sapply(logfc$logfc, function(x) {if(as.double(as.character(x)) >= 1 || is.na(x)){x} else {-1/x}})
# generate barplot
ggplot(logfc, aes(x = linearFC, y = Freq, fill = group)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "identity", show.legend = FALSE) + 
  xlab("linear fold change") +
  ylab("# tDEGenes (FDR < 10%)") +
  xlim(1, 1.5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.line.y.left = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.ticks.length = unit(.15, "cm"), axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black")) + 
  annotate("text", x = 1.4, y = 1.3, label = paste0("No. of genes upregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Upregulated", "group"])), size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.4, y = -1.3, label = paste0("No. of genes downregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Downregulated", "group"])), size = 4) + 
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T, end = 0.8)
ggsave(paste0(outpath, "/2.4_barplot_up_down_regulated_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"), width = 5.43, height = 3.45, units = "in")
rm(logfc)
```

Now, we generate violin plots for all gene hits.
```{r, echo = F}
for (hit in top_hits$`Ensembl Transcript ID`) {
  name <- top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"]
  # get exprs of top hit
  data <- as.data.frame(exprs(transcript_summaries)[top_hits[hit, "Ensembl Transcript ID"], ])
  colnames(data) <- "expression"
  data <- merge(data, pData(transcript_summaries)[, c("ShortName", "Dx")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName")
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Dx, y = expression, fill = Dx)) + 
    geom_violin() + 
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(title = paste0(top_hits[hit, "Ensembl Gene ID"], ": ", top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"]), x = element_blank(), y = "Expression values") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(2, begin = 0.3, end = 0.9, option = "D"), guide = FALSE, name = "", labels = c("Controls", "Cases"))
  ggsave(paste0(outpath, "/2.4_violinplot_significant_DEA_hits_transcripts_new_pvalue_and_fdr_", top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"],".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
}
rm(name, data)
```

Now, we combine the barplot of the number of differentially expressed genes, transcripts and exons per covariate (corrected for all other covariates). 
```{r, echo = F}
### ALL COMBINED (gene + transcript + exon barplot) ###
colnames(limma_res_gene) <- "counts"
limma_res_gene$type <- "gene"
limma_res_gene$covariates <- row.names(limma_res_gene)
colnames(limma_res_transcript) <- "counts"
limma_res_transcript$type <- "transcript"
limma_res_transcript$covariates <- row.names(limma_res_transcript)
colnames(limma_res_exon) <- "counts"
limma_res_exon$type <- "exon"
limma_res_exon$covariates <- row.names(limma_res_exon)
limma_res_all <- rbind(limma_res_gene, limma_res_transcript, limma_res_exon)
limma_res_all$covariates <- as.factor(limma_res_all$covariates)
limma_res_all$covariates <- factor(limma_res_all$covariates, levels = c("C4", "C3", "C2", "C1", "Type_of_Death","Suicide", "Sex", "RIN2", "RIN", "Diagnosis", "PMI", "pH", "Age"))
# save plot
pdf(paste0(outpath, "/1.1_barplots_significant_DEA_hits_gene_transcript_exon_combined.pdf"))
p <- ggplot(limma_res_all, aes(y = counts, x = covariates)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(axis.ticks = element_line(colour = NA), text = element_text(size = 22), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), strip.background =element_rect(fill = NA)) +
  ylab("# significant hits") +
  xlab("") +
  geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = limma_res_all$counts), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
p + facet_wrap(~ type, scale = "free_x") + theme(panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"))
dev.off()
# remove unnecessary data
rm(design, fit, top_hits, limma_res_exon, limma_res_transcript, limma_res_all, p)
```

## Figures for the tDEGenes

Now we generate some plots for the found eDEgenes. First, we will plot a heatmap of the 2224 eDEGenes.
```{r, echo = F}
# get only top hits (2224 eDEGenes)
top_hits <- top_hits[top_hits$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
# ǵenerate heatmap of hits
anno <- pData(exon_summaries)[, c("Age", "PMI", "RIN", "Sex", "Suicide", "Dx", "ShortName")]
rownames(anno) <- anno$ShortName
anno$ShortName <- NULL
pheatmap(exprs(exon_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID`, ], scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, show_colnames = F, show_rownames = F)
pheatmap(exprs(exon_summaries)[top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID`, ], scale = "row", annotation_col = anno, show_colnames = F, show_rownames = F, filename = paste0(outpath, "/1.3_heatmap_significant_DEA_hits_exons_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"))
rm(anno)
```

Then, we plot the up and down regulated genes into one barplot with the two variables mirrored on the x-axis.
```{r, echo = F}
logfc <- as.data.frame(table(top_hits$logFC))
logfc$group <- "Upregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "group"] <- "Downregulated"
logfc[as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)) < 0, "Freq"] <- -1
logfc$Var1 <- abs(round(as.numeric(as.character(logfc$Var1)), 2))
logfc$logfc <- 2^logfc$Var1
logfc$linearFC <- sapply(logfc$logfc, function(x) {if(as.double(as.character(x)) >= 1 || is.na(x)){x} else {-1/x}})
min(logfc$linearFC)
max(logfc$linearFC)
mean(logfc$linearFC)
ggplot(logfc, aes(x = linearFC, y = Freq, fill = group)) + 
  geom_histogram(stat = "identity", show.legend = FALSE) + 
  xlab("Linear fold change") +
  ylab("# tDEGenes (FDR < 10%)") +
  xlim(1, 1.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.line.y.left = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.ticks.length = unit(.15, "cm"), axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black")) + 
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 30, label = paste0("No. of genes upregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Upregulated", "group"])), size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = -30, label = paste0("No. of genes downregulated: ", length(logfc[logfc$group == "Downregulated", "group"])), size = 4) + 
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = T, end = 0.8)
ggsave(paste0(outpath, "/1.3_barplot_up_down_regulated_significant_DEA_hits_exons_new_pvalue_and_fdr.pdf"), width = 5.43, height = 3.45, units = "in")
rm(logfc)
```

Now, we generate violin plots for the top six hits.
```{r, echo = F}
for (hit in top_hits$`Ensembl Exon ID`[1:6]) {
  name <- top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"]
  # get exprs of top hit
  data <- as.data.frame(exprs(exon_summaries)[top_hits[hit, "Ensembl Exon ID"], ])
  colnames(data) <- "expression"
  data <- merge(data, pData(exon_summaries)[, c("ShortName", "Dx")], by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName")
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Dx, y = expression, fill = Dx)) + 
    geom_violin() + 
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(title = top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"], x = element_blank(), y = "Expression values") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Controls", "Cases")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(2, begin = 0.3, end = 0.9, option = "D"), guide = FALSE, name = "", labels = c("Controls", "Cases"))
  ggsave(paste0(outpath, "/1.3_violinplot_significant_DEA_hits_exons_new_pvalue_and_fdr_", top_hits[hit, "Gene Symbol"],".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
}
rm(name, data)
```


# Age DEGenes

## Load data

First, we need to load the gene-based (gDEGenes), transcript-based (tDEGenes) and exon-based (eDEGenes) differentially expressed genes for age. Then, we filter the data for only significant (FDR < 10%) genes. 

```{r}
# gene-level
gDEGenes_age <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_age.csv", select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), data.table = F)
bck_gDEGenes_age <- unique(sort(gDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
gDEGenes_age <- gDEGenes_age[gDEGenes_age$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]

# transcript-level
tDEGenes_age <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_age_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv", select = c("FDR estimate", "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID"), data.table = F)
bck_tDEGenes_age <- unique(sort(tDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
tDEGenes_age <- tDEGenes_age[tDEGenes_age$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]

# exon-level
eDEGenes_age <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/1.3_diff_expr_exons_for_age_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv", select = c("FDR estimate", "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID"), data.table = F)
bck_eDEGenes_age <- unique(sort(eDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
eDEGenes_age <- eDEGenes_age[eDEGenes_age$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
```

## Overlap to known ageing genes

Now, we are interested in how many of the differentially expressed age genes are overlapping to a database of known ageing genes for human. Therefore, we use the ageing gene database called GenAge and download all human age related genes from their website: https://genomics.senescence.info/download.html

First, we load the known ageing genes from the GenAge database. 

```{r}
ageing_genes <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2019_Human_Ageing_Genomic_Resources/genage_human.csv", select = "symbol", data.table = F)
```

Then, we calculate the overlap to the single age DEGenes from our dataset:

```{r}
# gDEGenes
length(intersect(ageing_genes$symbol, gDEGenes_age$`Gene Symbol`))

# tDEGenes
length(intersect(ageing_genes$symbol, tDEGenes_age$`Gene Symbol`))

# eDEGenes
length(intersect(ageing_genes$symbol, eDEGenes_age$`Gene Symbol`))
```

Now, we can also check the significance (p-value) of the overlap from our age DEGenes to the known age genes. Therefore, we first need to generate a contingency table and then run Fisher's exact test:

1. gDEGenes: `r FishersExactTest(gDEGenes_age[, "Gene Symbol"], ageing_genes$symbol, bck_gDEGenes_age)`
2. tDEGenes: `r FishersExactTest(tDEGenes_age[, "Gene Symbol"], ageing_genes$symbol, bck_tDEGenes_age)`
3. eDEGenes: `r FishersExactTest(eDEGenes_age[, "Gene Symbol"], ageing_genes$symbol, bck_eDEGenes_age)`

## VENN diagram

When, we will generate a VENN diagram for the overlap of found eDEGenes, tDEGenes and eDEGenes for age and save it into a pdf file.  

```{r}
gDEGenes_age <- unique(gDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`)
tDEGenes_age <- unique(tDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`)
eDEGenes_age <- unique(eDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`)
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.1_VENN_DEGenes_for_age.pdf")
grid.newpage()
overrideTriple=T
draw.triple.venn(area1 = length(gDEGenes_age), area2 = length(tDEGenes_age),                  area3 = length(eDEGenes_age), 
                 n12 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, tDEGenes_age)), 
                 n23 = length(intersect(tDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age)), 
                 n13 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age)),
                 euler.d = F, scaled = F, 
                 n123 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, intersect(tDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age))),  
                 category = c(paste("gDEGenes", length(gDEGenes_age), sep = "\n"), paste("tDEGenes", length(tDEGenes_age), sep = "\n"), paste("eDEGenes", length(eDEGenes_age), sep = "\n")), 
                 lty = "blank", fill = c(rgb(red = 255, green = 167, blue = 42, maxColorValue = 255), rgb(red = 66, green = 146, blue = 198, maxColorValue = 255), rgb(red = 158, green = 212, blue = 0, maxColorValue = 255)))
dev.off()
```

After finishing all the analysis, we will delete unnecessary data. 

```{r}
rm(gDEGenes_age, tDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age, ageing_genes)
```

# Gene set (Pathway) enrichment analysis

## Load data

First, we will read in the tDEGenes and eDEGenes for diagnosis. 

```{r}
# tDEGenes 
tDEGenes <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv", sep = "\t", select = c("Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), stringsAsFactors = F)
tDEGenes <- tDEGenes[tDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, `Gene Symbol`]

# eDEGenes
eDEGenes <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/1.3_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv", sep = "\t", select = c("Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), stringsAsFactors = F)

# save background gene number (all given genes from the dataset)
background_genes <- as.data.frame(eDEGenes[!is.na(eDEGenes$`Gene Symbol`) & eDEGenes$`Gene Symbol` != "", ])[, "Gene Symbol"]

# get only significant hits
eDEGenes <- eDEGenes[eDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, `Gene Symbol`]
```

## VENN overlap

Before, we perform the GSEA, we will generate a VENN diagram of the overlap of the tDEGenes and eDEGenes. As all six tDEGenes are also eDEGene hits, the VENN diagram should display a huge circle (2,224 eDEGenes) with a smaller circle (6 tDEGenes) inside. 

```{r}
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_VENN_tDEGenes_eDEGenes_overlap.pdf")
grid.newpage()
draw.pairwise.venn(area1 = length(tDEGenes), area2 = length(eDEGenes), cross.area = length(intersect(tDEGenes, eDEGenes)), fill = c(rgb(red = 66, green = 146, blue = 198, maxColorValue = 255), rgb(red = 158, green = 212, blue = 0, maxColorValue = 255)), category = c(paste("tDEGenes", length(tDEGenes), sep = "\n"), paste("eDEGenes", length(eDEGenes), sep = "\n")), lty = "blank", cex = 2)
dev.off()
```

## Load MSigDB

For the gene set enrichment, sometimes also called pathway enrichment, we will use the sub-collection of "Canonical pathways" from the "C2: curated gene sets" and the "c5: gene ontology (GO) gene sets" of the Molecular Signature DataBase (MSigDB) downloaded from the GSEA website: http://software.broadinstitute.org/gsea/downloads.jsp

We load the data as Gene Set Collections (multiple Gene Sets), where the gene set (pathway) name is the key and all included genes (symbols) of the gene set are stored in a list (value). It is similar to a dictionary in python or a hashmap in Java with a key (gene set name) and value (list of included genes) pair.

```{r}
# load MSigDB c2 - canonical pathways
all_canonical <- getGmt("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2020_MSigDB/msigdb_v7.0_files_to_download_locally/msigdb_v7.0_GMTs/c2.cp.v7.0.symbols.gmt", 
                  collectionType = BroadCollection(category = "c2"),  
                  geneIdType = SymbolIdentifier())
# load MSigDB c5 - gene ontology (GO) 
all_go <- getGmt("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2020_MSigDB/msigdb_v7.0_files_to_download_locally/msigdb_v7.0_GMTs/c5.all.v7.0.symbols.gmt", 
                  collectionType = BroadCollection(category = "c5"),  
                  geneIdType = SymbolIdentifier())
```

**TODO:** As the gene symbols are not as sufficient as Ensembl Gene IDs, we will map the gene symbols to Ensembl IDs using the latest GENCODE file created on GRCh37 (hg19) release 19 (downloaded from: https://www.gencodegenes.org/human/release_19.html). 

## Gene set (Pathway) enrichment analysis

Now, we use the MGSA tool to find pathways which are enriched for our dataset.

### MSigDB - Canonical Pathways

```{r}
cp_mgsa <- list()
for (gset in all_canonical) {
  t <- list(gset@geneIds)
 cp_mgsa <- c(cp_mgsa, t)
}
names(cp_mgsa) <- names(all_canonical)
set.seed(0)  # necessary to get the same results all the time!!
cp_res <- mgsa(o = as.character(eDEGenes[!is.na(eDEGenes)]), sets = cp_mgsa, population = as.character(background_genes))
plot(cp_res)
dev.off()

mgsa_res_cp <- setsResults(cp_res)
head(mgsa_res_cp[order(mgsa_res_cp$estimate, decreasing = T),])
write.table(mgsa_res_cp, file = "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/3_GSEA_MGSA_MSigDB_c2_canonical_pathways_results.tsv")

# save only the significant pathways (score > 0.5)
mgsa_res_cp <- mgsa_res_cp[mgsa_res_cp$estimate > 0.5, ]
mgsa_res_cp <- mgsa_res_cp[!(row.names(mgsa_res_cp) == "NA"), ]
plot_mgsa_cp <- as.data.frame(mgsa_res_cp[order(mgsa_res_cp$estimate, decreasing = T), ])
## set the levels in order we want
bp <- ggplot(data = plot_mgsa_cp, aes(x = reorder(row.names(plot_mgsa_cp), estimate), y = estimate)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + xlab("") + coord_flip() + theme_minimal() + ggtitle("MsigDB: c2 - cp")
bp + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")
ggsave("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.1_barplot_eDEGenes_MSigDB_top10_enriched_c2_canonical_pathways.pdf", width = 5, height = 2)
```

# Transcripts per Gene

Now, we will plot the distribution of Ensembl Transcript IDs per Ensembl Gene ID. We will plot the distribution in our filtered expression dataset as well as the original transcripts per gene found in GENCODE (for hg19). 

```{r, echo = F}
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/01_RData_Files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_transcript_summaries_annotated.RData")
features <- fData(transcript_summaries)[, c("transcript_id", "gene_id")]
features <- separate_rows(features, transcript_id, gene_id, sep = "\\|")
features <- features[!duplicated(features), ]
freqs <- as.data.frame(table(as.data.frame(table(features$gene_id))$Freq))

# load gene to transcript info from Gencode and filter exactly like in the preprocessing step
genes <- import.gff("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2018_MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/annotation_files/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf", format = "gtf")
genes <- genes[genes$gene_type == "protein_coding"]  
genes <- genes[genes$type == "transcript"]
genes <- genes[genes$source == "HAVANA"]
genes <- as.data.frame(genes)[, c("gene_id", "transcript_id")]

# get only Ensembl gene IDs for which we have transcripts (see above)
genes <- genes[genes$gene_id %in% features$gene_id, ]
genes <- genes[!duplicated(genes), ]
freqs2 <- as.data.frame(table(as.data.frame(table(genes$gene_id))$Freq))

# merge the two datasets
tfreq <- merge(freqs, freqs2, by = "Var1", all = T)
tfreq[is.na(tfreq$Freq.x), "Freq.x"] <- 0
tfreq[is.na(tfreq$Freq.y), "Freq.y"] <- 0
colnames(tfreq) <- c("TranscriptCount", "ExpressionFreq", "OriginalFreq")
tfreq <- reshape2::melt(tfreq, id.vars = "TranscriptCount")
tfreq$TranscriptCount <- as.numeric(tfreq$TranscriptCount)

ggplot(tfreq, aes(x = TranscriptCount, y = value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15), legend.position = c(0.9, 0.9), legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "black"), legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "# transcripts per gene", y = "# genes") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridis(2, begin = 0.3, end = 0.9, option = "D"), labels = c("Own data", "GENCODE"))  
ggsave("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_plot_transcripts_per_gene_gencode_vs_own_data.pdf")
rm(features, genes, freqs, freqs2, tfreq)
```
